• Children with suspected TB require pediatric evaluation and age-appropriate treatment.
• Older adults should be monitored for medicine side effects and interactions.
• Persistent cough, coughing blood, severe breathing difficulty, confusion, or worsening symptoms requires prompt medical attention.
